items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: I just told you I want to go to old man Weller. Weller? Weller? Weller here every time he come back he likes old man bringing his kid toys...

ctx.x: Well don't worry about it we got it down on the pictures. What was that Stand It All band like? Did you fit in there okay? Oh yeah. You didn't have any trouble? It must have been a big band huh? You didn't have to read?

Oh yes it was a big band. Well I read when I wanted to have a different one I did. In other words I was my own boss. I just told you I want to go to old man Weller. Weller? Weller? Weller here every time he come back he likes old man bringing his kid toys and say he'd bring me more dirt and poofy. Anything in the line of a musical instrument otherwise he got it. And man when that jazz band went out there you better not tell him that's gold.
It's not like that. You had a jazz band in this band?
